title: TR-808 Drum Machine
description: Synthesized 808-style drum kit, one page per voice
longDescription: The Drum Machine page runs an 8-track, 16-step pattern from the master clock. Each track sends its trigger through a Link In to its own voice page (Bass Drum, Snare, Closed/Open Hi-Hat, Clap, Low/High Tom, Cowbell). Every voice is built only from oscillators, noise, envelopes and filters and plays on its own To Master bus (1-8). The fx page mixes the eight buses to all audio outputs; use the Audio Outputs sliders or the Drum Mix gains to balance the kit. Set the Run const to 0 to stop the sequencer.
